snippet.title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the storybook, lest you become one.

In The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster, a story-driven puzzle adventure game by the creators of The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince, a mysterious disease is turning people into picture books. When her sister contracts Paper Mortis, Mono must do everything she can to save her—even if that means making a deal with a veritable devil.

Step into a hand-drawn fairytale, one book at a time, in this tragic tale. Solve puzzles, fight bosses, and do whatever it takes to save your sister!

The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster comes out for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC in 2027.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates!

Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/grimm-reapress/
